One accountable contractor may use disclosed, appropriately credentialed subcontractors. Unable to estimate yet requires a reason and is a prominent comparison caution, not a selection block. Approved sourcing checkpoint: at 12 noon Singapore time on the second calendar date after RFQ/new-round publication, fewer than three distinct eligible contractors with current selectable quotes alerts Admin to chase offline. Zero is included. Revisions count once; ineligible/expired/withdrawn/non-selectable offers are excluded. Preserve C35/C36/Q4: a minor correction does not invalidate a quote; a material scope change requires reconfirmation/revision before selection or inclusion in current valid coverage. Initial valid quotes need no site-visit/readiness gate. This is not a three-quote selection gate. Stop obsolete sourcing reminders after selection/cancellation; ordinary edits do not reset the clock. V13: the 5/10-business-day selection reminder clock starts only with three distinct valid quotes. Below three, continue sourcing; if coverage later drops, pause selection reminders and resume remaining time on restoration. Owner explicitly retained selection with fewer quotes using the existing warning/rationale.

nodes.label: Contractor prepares to start
nodes.pending: Pending: Contractor to begin the authorised work
nodes.trigger: At/below-threshold selection, or required MCST approval, creates work authorisation.
nodes.checkpoint: Before Start is enabled, Contractor must supply either Completed by: date and time, or Unable to estimate yet with a nonblank reason. Validate the same requirement on submission. Start records actual commencement and the chosen estimate/reason together; no actual start event is recorded if validation fails. If Unable to estimate is used at Start, create a temporary estimate obligation due 24 elapsed hours after that actual Start event. By then provide Completed by date/time or obtain a reasoned Admin extension with a new deadline; Contractor cannot self-extend this exception. Missing the estimate-submission deadline alerts Admin immediately.
nodes.note: A future agreed start shows Scheduled: Contractor starts on [date/time], with no implication of lateness before that date. Completed by is a target, not a completion event; changes record reasons/history. Q18 approved: estimate/date-time or Unable to estimate yet plus reason is a prerequisite to Start. Show a concise explanation alongside the unavailable Start control. Estimate choice does not bypass work authorisation. Access issue examples: CM arranges keys/entry or a site shutdown; Contractor supplies worker details/tools. Assign the actual party. Access does not automatically become an admin dispute. Quote-stage uncertainty can be genuine (for example extent unknown before diagnosis); after Start it is now time-limited under approved O34-B. Admin extension records author, reason, old/new deadline and time. This does not invent a completion date or bypass other work authorisation. The 24-hour obligation is to provide the first estimate, not to finish the job. Example: Start Monday 10:00 -> supply Completed by by Tuesday 10:00. Only Admin extends that submission deadline; normal later completion-date proposals go to the authorised CM/MCST. Approved missed-start follow-up: at an agreed scheduled start with no recorded Start, alert Admin using Start has not been recorded. After 24 elapsed hours notify relevant CM/MCST only if Start is still unrecorded. Stop obsolete notices after recorded Start, cancellation or an authorised superseding schedule. Do not infer that physical work has not begun merely because the update is missing; do not start the separate 24h estimate obligation before actual Start is recorded.

nodes.label: Contractor carries out work
nodes.pending: Pending: Contractor to complete the work
nodes.trigger: Contractor records the start.
nodes.checkpoint: Work is complete opens one completion form: compulsory invoice, optional photos, final irreversible declaration and slide submission. Opening or saving the draft does not declare completion.
nodes.note: Approved UX9 replaces the separate declare-completion then upload-invoice sequence. W2 wording and optional Add update remain. The contractor cannot undo the submitted declaration; Admin recovery preserves it. Estimate is distinct from actual completion. Temporary Unable to estimate expires as an allowed exception at Start + 24 elapsed hours unless Admin grants a reasoned new deadline. A missed Completed by target alerts Admin immediately. Both relevant CM and MCST receive the late-work notice 24 elapsed hours after the target only if completion remains outstanding; show hours late and Okay / Admin Intervention. Okay acknowledges that notice only. Completion before the reminder suppresses it but remains late if after the target; completion before the target is never late. Contractor proposes revised date/time and required reason; notify CM/MCST for authorised Okay (accept exact new date) or Admin Intervention (support, not acceptance). Keep the last authorised target until acceptance/override; retain all reasons, dates, decisions and overdue history. Use the existing variation decision machinery for this compact schedule-only change. The initial Start +24h obligation is a deadline to supply the first estimate; only Admin can extend that separate deadline.
fields: Completed by: date + time OR Unable to estimate yet + reason, carried forward from Start
Temporary estimate obligation and recorded deadline, or current Completed by target with revision history
Revised completion date/time + required reason; authorised CM/MCST response: Okay / Admin Intervention

nodes.checkpoint: Invoice required; photos optional. Final slide submits the invoice version and irreversible completion declaration together, then assigns CM review.
nodes.note: Preparing Proof & Payment is the form heading, not another post-completion ticket phase. Drafts remain editable and do not record physical completion. Proposed replacement popup: Confirm that all work is finished. Once submitted, this completion declaration cannot be undone. Your invoice will be submitted with it, and the CM will then inspect the work.

nodes.label: CM reviews completion
nodes.pending: Pending: CM reviews the work and invoice
nodes.trigger: Contractor submits the initial completion package, or submits completed corrections for a NEW remedy round after an unsatisfactory inspection.
nodes.checkpoint: CM inspects the currently submitted work/repair round and reviews the invoice. EVERY corrective-work resubmission requires a fresh inspection. Approve Works applies only to that inspected round/version, with the positive checkbox and slide. Failed inspection returns to R2. Invoice mismatch or unapproved scope prevents advancement.
nodes.note: Unsatisfactory work belongs to the CM here: incomplete/unsatisfactory work, defects or scope/invoice concerns. It leads to response/remedy instead of requiring a false positive checkbox. This is distinct from contractor Payment Issue. Admin backtracking preserves original declarations/review events. Unsatisfactory work is the CM completion-quality branch, available without the positive checkbox. It does not rename intake Report an issue, Payment Issue, or Request Admin Support. Invoice-only mismatches still route to R3. Example: 4 November inspection fails; Contractor submits corrected work on 8 November; CM must inspect the corrected work again before acceptance. A prior failed result is never reusable acceptance. Keep round ID, submitted repair version, inspection date, findings and inspector. The newly issued round starts its own two/five-business-day unanswered-review clock. Inspection sequence is recorded per original ticket, with linked aftercare case ID where applicable. Display Inspection for n=1; Inspection [2nd], Inspection [3rd], Inspection [4th] and the correct ordinal for n>=2. The first suffix [1st] is hidden. Each result and its unsatisfactory findings retain their own inspection ID, ordinal, actor, date/time and repair version. Carry prior findings forward by reference without relabelling them as a new finding. Opening a form, supplying photos or correcting only an invoice does not invent another physical inspection.
fields: Checkbox above Approve Works: I agree the works are Complete and Satisfactory
Inspection heading: Inspection / Inspection [2nd] / Inspection [3rd] / Inspection [4th]
Findings tagged to their originating inspection; current round links prior failures

If invoice details alone change and physical work/scope do not, separately approved invoice-only reconciliation can preserve the still-valid work acceptance. That exception cannot skip inspection of new physical corrections. Show each unsatisfactory item with the label of the inspection that found it. Example: Inspection [2nd] — leak persists at valve joint; the next submitted repair will require Inspection [3rd]. Preserve initial findings under Inspection, without [1st].

nodes.pending: Pending: Contractor explains or corrects the invoice
nodes.trigger: Invoice differs from authorised quote plus effective variations.

Approved UX10: if only the invoice changed and work acceptance remains valid, go directly to R4 after reconciliation; repeat R1 only if inspection is outstanding or a relevant work/scope fact changed.
nodes.note: MCST and admin are notified because an invoice mismatch was detected. Routine variation approval remains with the required CM/MCST approver. An admin notification is not an approval or a resolution. A rejected invoice-stage change returns here for correction, not to physical work. View Reason opens the discrepancy detail; Contractor can explain/correct there, while CM/MCST can read the reason when submitted. Until a reason exists show the detected difference and that an explanation is pending. Viewing is not resolution. Approved ordinary follow-up: remind the actual responsible actor after two business days unanswered and alert Admin after five, unless a specific applicable task/case rule supplies its date. No duplicate MCST-approval timer and no approval inferred from silence.

Preserve the file/version and submitting identity. No routine Admin approval or automatic claim of document authenticity is added. Missing/contradictory proof and payment concerns use the same Admin Support case. Existing reminders chase a missing MCST entry; cancellation settlement uses this same form with context retained.

countdown.authority: Follow-up timing and these two role-specific countdown lines explicitly approved in v10; no MCST bank-payment deadline.

Admin checks whether payment has actually been sent and helps obtain the record or progress update. A bank payment is not presumed unpaid merely because an app entry is missing. No app-imposed MCST payment deadline, penalty, cancellation, or payment extension. Stop obsolete missing-record reminders when supplied; keep real balance/receipt tasks.
